tests.description: Reference: NCAR fire_behavior test7 (80x80 fire cells of 25 m, dt = 0.5 s, num_tiles = 1), default real32 build, dumped in-model by the ctessum-claude/fire_behavior fork (-DESM_DUMP=ON; summary output bit-identical to the uninstrumented build). Single precision: rel 1e-5 (CLAUDE.md contract). Regime: cell (i,j) = (16, 60), step 20 (ts = 10 s), the front crosses the cell during step 20 (lfn_in > 0 >= lfn_out): interpolated ignition time.

Single precision: rel 1e-5 (CLAUDE.md contract). Regime: cell (i,j) = (17, 60), step 20 (ts = 10 s), already burning (lfn_in <= 0): ignition time unchanged.
